versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the HeyRepli skill.
- Scrape, generate AI replies, and publish or schedule social posts across 7 platforms using the HeyRepli API.
- Support for retrieving YouTube transcripts, fetching TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and Facebook post data.
- Includes brand mention tracking, analytics, and usage/quota checking.
- Detailed setup, API workflow, and tool usage instructions provided in SKILL.md.
- Documents key caveats including naming mismatches, OAuth requirements, rate limits, and error handling.
